about: compiler/receipt: deterministic location resolution across symlinks, Go build flags, build/test receipts, and pure testinputs closure manifests (SELFHOST-LEDGER-RECEIPT).

mutants.name: selfhost-ledger-receipt-dangling-link
mutants.rule: resolveRawPreserveDotDot must fail immediately with dangling-link reason rather than walking into missing targets.

mutants.name: selfhost-ledger-receipt-inputs-digest-verify
mutants.rule: VerifyBuildReceipt must reject receipts whose InputsDigest does not match the expected digest.

mutants.name: selfhost-ledger-receipt-locate-links-before-dotdot
mutants.from: let res = try resolveRawPreserveDotDot(wd, spelled, links)
mutants.rule: Locate must resolve symlinks before collapsing .. segments rather than lexically cleaning first.

mutants.name: selfhost-ledger-access-stop-at-dash
mutants.rule: TestLogFlag must stop scanning CLI flags at the -- argument separator.

mutants.name: selfhost-ledger-access-filter-virtual
mutants.rule: FilterAndSortManifest must exclude virtual procfs, sysfs, and devfs paths from recorded inputs.

mutants.name: selfhost-ledger-access-reject-newline
mutants.rule: FilterAndSortManifest must fail closed when a recorded path contains a newline character.
